title: Deuteronomy
introduction: Deuteronomy records Moses' final addresses to Israel on the plains of Moab, restating the covenant, the law, and the choice between blessing and curse before the crossing of the Jordan. These ten studies follow literary divisions; they do not claim ten independently dated historical events. Archaeology, historical reconstruction, and later interpretation are distinguished from biblical testimony.
